note: Tre polimorfi anidri di baloxavir marboxil (Form I, II, III). Form III: struttura non risolta ('structure solution of Form III was not successful thus far'), ottenuta solo per precipitazione sotto agitazione. Il disordine posizionale della catena metilmetil carbonato in Form I (occupazioni 0.606(5):0.394(5)) non e' un evento. Il campione di Form I del DSC mostra un primo evento endotermico a 230.4 °C attribuito a un cambio di fase (forma di arrivo non identificata, E1) seguito dalla fusione del solido ottenuto (E2). Nessuna relazione mono/enantiotropa dichiarata: l'articolo dice solo che Form III si converte nella Form I «less soluble» in sospensione, senza usare «more stable» (relazioni vuote). L'articolo scrive «BMX» in alcuni punti e «BXM» in altri (stesso composto); in Table 1 la colonna T riporta 296 e 170 K senza dire a quale forma: attribuzione per ordine delle colonne (Form I, Form II). Table S1 (screening di cristallizzazione) e le Figure S10-S11 stanno nel supplementare.

citazioni: the DSC curve of Form I exhibited two thermal events: a small endothermic event at 230.4 ◦C followed by a sharply deﬁned melting event at 238.7 ◦C.
The ﬁrst endothermic peak was associated with a phase change since there was no mass loss in this temperature range.
Approximately 4–7 mg powder samples were placed in an aluminum pan, and the heating was carried out at a rate of 10 ◦C/min under a nitrogen ﬂow of 50 mL/min.
eventi.note: Transizione solido-solido di Form I vista in DSC come evento endotermico «small» a 230.4 °C, attribuita a un cambio di fase perche' la TGA non mostra perdita di massa. La forma di arrivo non e' identificata (a: ignota). Il testo non dice se 230.4 °C sia onset o picco.

citazioni: the DSC curve of Form I exhibited two thermal events: a small endothermic event at 230.4 ◦C followed by a sharply deﬁned melting event at 238.7 ◦C.
The second one resulted from the melting of the obtained solid in the phase transition process.

The DSC thermal analysis shows that three polymorphs exhibit an explosive type of degradation at melting, which is accompanied by a large release of heat. The melting was irreversible and resulted in a dark-brown tar.
Approximately 4–7 mg powder samples were placed in an aluminum pan, and the heating was carried out at a rate of 10 ◦C/min under a nitrogen ﬂow of 50 mL/min.
eventi.note: Fusione del solido ottenuto dal cambio di fase di E1 («the melting of the obtained solid in the phase transition process»), non della Form I tal quale: da e' la fase non identificata di E1. Fusione con degradazione «explosive type», irreversibile, residuo «dark-brown tar». Il segno dell'evento a 238.7 °C non e' scritto (il testo dice «endothermic» solo per il primo evento): segno null.

condizioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: 1.0 g in 900 mL pH 1.2 simulated gastric fluids

citazioni: The powder dissolution behaviors of the BXM polymorphs determined in pH 1.2 simulated gastric ﬂuids at 37 ◦C are demonstrated in Figure 6.

The powder dissolution experiments were carried out in a Tianda Tianfa Technology RC806D dissolution tester with a paddle rotation speed of 100 rpm at 37 ◦C. Precisely weighted samples (1.0 g) were added into the dissolution vessels with 900 mL pH 1.2 simulated gastric ﬂuids.

With increasing time, BXM concentration in solution decreases, and after 40 min, the concentration is close to that of Form I, indicating that the precipitation process (Form I) is happening, and Form III converts into less soluble Form I under suspension condition.

After the dissolution study, the remaining solid phase was characterized by PXRD analysis (Figure S10). It was conﬁrmed that Form III almost converted to Form I as expected, while Form I and II retained their respective crystal forms, and there is no change even if suspended in water for seven days.
eventi.note: Conversione di Form III in Form I durante la prova di dissoluzione in polvere (pH 1.2, 37 °C): a 40 min la concentrazione si avvicina a quella di Form I (precipitazione di Form I), e il PXRD finale del solido residuo conferma che «Form III almost converted to Form I». Il tempo di 40 min e' ricavato dalla curva di concentrazione (non da un PXRD a quel tempo): tipo osservata senza min. «almost»: conversione quasi completa, non completa; esito avvenuta.

citazioni: Form I was prepared by recrystallization of BXM in methanol. In particular, 500 mg of BXM was dissolved in 35 mL of methanol, the solution was ﬁltered, and slow cooling of the solution yielded Form I.

For crystal structure determination, good quality crystals of Form I were produced by dissolving 20 mg of BXM in 10 mL methanol. Slow evaporation at 25 ◦C produced block crystals after approximately 1 week.

preparazioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: 500 mg in 10 mL of acetonitrile; 15 mL of n-heptane
citazioni: Form II was prepared from acetonitrile solution of BXM by adding n-heptane as an antisolvent. In particular, 500 mg of BXM was dissolved in 10 mL of acetonitrile, and the resultant clear solution cooled to 0 ◦C; 15 mL of n-heptane was dropped over 10 min. The prepared mixture became cloudy and then ﬁltered.
preparazioni.note: n-heptane aggiunto goccia a goccia in 10 min alla soluzione in acetonitrile raffreddata a 0 °C.

preparazioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: 20 mg in a mixture of 3 mL acetonitrile and 7 mL n-heptane
citazioni: Crystals of Form II for crystal structure determination were produced by dissolving 20 mg of BXM in a mixture of 3 mL acetonitrile
and 7 mL n-heptane. Slow evaporation at 25 ◦C produced rod-like crystals after about 10 days.
preparazioni.note: Cristalli per la diffrazione (SCXRD). Il testo e' interrotto dall'intestazione di pagina fra «acetonitrile» e «and 7 mL n-heptane».

preparazioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: 500 mg in 50 mL of ethyl acetate
citazioni: Form III was prepared by recrystallization of BXM in ethyl acetate. In particular, 500 mg of BXM was dissolved in 50 mL of ethyl acetate. The prepared solution was then stirred and quickly cooled to 0 ◦C. The obtained cloudy solution was ﬁltered.
preparazioni.note: Raffreddamento rapido sotto agitazione; «it was obtained only by stir precipitation».

citazioni: Unfortunately, slow crystallization in ethyl acetate does not result in Form III but in Form I.
preparazioni.note: Cristallizzazione lenta (modo non precisato) in acetato di etile: non da' Form III ma Form I.

descrizioni.testo: homochiral: S-configuration at C10 and R-configuration at C15 (polarimetric data)
descrizioni.citazione: Homochirality of the BMX molecules in both polymorphic forms had been determined from polarimetric data, all molecules having the S-conﬁguration at C10 and the R-conﬁguration at C15.

descrizioni.testo: the only difference between the conformations in Form I and II is the rotation of the methymethyl carbonate chain
descrizioni.citazione: Overlaying the molecular conformations found in Form II with that of I shows that the only difference is the rotation of the methymethyl carbonate chain, while the other bonds overlay nicely (Figure 2d).

descrizioni.testo: the formation of different solid forms is not due to changes in molecular conformation
descrizioni.citazione: This result indicates that the formation of different solid forms is not due to changes in molecular conformation.

descrizioni.testo: no typical O-H or N-H donor, 10 hydrogen bond acceptors; packing governed by nonclassic hydrogen bonds
descrizioni.citazione: Since the absence of a typical O-H or N-H donor but with 10 hydrogen bond acceptors in the BXM molecule, the formation of crystal packing arrangement for BXM is governed by a network of nonclassic hydrogen bonds.
